title: delete_task
description: Permanently delete a task for the authenticated user. This tool should be used when the user wants to remove, delete, or discard a task. Natural language examples: 'Delete my dentist task', 'Remove the grocery item', 'Get rid of that task'. NOTE: If task_id is not provided, the agent should first use list_tasks to find the matching task.

user_id.description: The authenticated user's ID (extracted from JWT token). Required for user data isolation.

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task to delete. If not provided by user, agent should use list_tasks to find matching task by title/description.

success.description: Whether the task was deleted successfully

deleted_task_id.description: The ID of the deleted task

message.description: User-friendly confirmation message (e.g., 'Deleted task: Buy groceries')

errors.description: Task with given ID does not exist or does not belong to user
User ID mismatch or invalid JWT token
Failed to delete task from database

agent_notes: If user references a task by title/description (e.g., 'delete the grocery task'), chain list_tasks first to find the task_id
If multiple tasks match, ask user to clarify which one
If no tasks match, inform user that task doesn't exist
Deletion is permanent - confirm with user if ambiguous ('Are you sure you want to delete...')
